content.json:
## Meternaut history

What Meternaut did, step by step: every run, every lead it found, every case it took up and what each model said. It is read from the telemetry of the cases app and kept for a year. Figures are Cost Management cost lines in US dollars, not invoices. A saving is computed by code, never by a model. Nothing on this page changes Azure.

If a table says "Query failed" or "could not connect to server": the portal reads this data from your browser, and a network that resolves the Azure Monitor query addresses to a private IP address (for example a corporate VPN) cannot reach it. That is the network, not the query. The Meternaut console shows the same runs and cases from its own records, and works from any network that can reach the console.

parameters.name: Run
parameters.label: Run
parameters.query:
let runs = traces
| where message startswith 'meternaut_event '
| extend e = parse_json(substring(message, 16))
| where tostring(e.type) in ('run.started', 'run.failed')
| summarize Started = min(timestamp) by RunId = tostring(e.runId)
| project value = RunId, label = strcat(format_datetime(Started, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), ' UTC, run ', substring(RunId, 0, 8)), sortKey = 1, Started;
union (print value = '*', label = 'All runs', sortKey = 0, Started = now()), runs
| order by sortKey asc, Started desc
| project value, label

content.title: Runs
content.query:
traces
| where message startswith 'meternaut_event '
| extend e = parse_json(substring(message, 16))
| extend type = tostring(e.type), runId = tostring(e.runId)
| summarize started = minif(timestamp, type == 'run.started'), finished = maxif(timestamp, type in ('run.finished', 'run.failed')), trigger = anyif(tostring(e.trigger), type == 'run.started'), leads = countif(type == 'lead.found'), cases = countif(type == 'case.result'), proposed = countif(type == 'case.result' and tostring(e.status) == 'proposed'), needsPerson = countif(type == 'case.result' and tostring(e.status) == 'needs_human'), dropped = countif(type == 'case.result' and tostring(e.status) == 'dropped'), errors = countif(type == 'case.result' and tostring(e.status) == 'error'), tokens = sumif(toint(e.tokens), type == 'run.finished'), failed = countif(type == 'run.failed') by runId
| extend seconds = datetime_diff('second', finished, started)
| project Started = started, Run = runId, Trigger = trigger, Leads = leads, Cases = cases, Proposed = proposed, ['Needs a person'] = needsPerson, Dropped = dropped, Errors = errors, Tokens = tokens, Seconds = seconds, Failed = failed
| order by Started desc

content.title: What Meternaut found and what it decided
content.query:
traces
| where message startswith 'meternaut_event '
| extend e = parse_json(substring(message, 16))
| where tostring(e.type) == 'case.result'
| where '{Run}' == '*' or tostring(e.runId) == '{Run}'
| project When = timestamp, Resource = tostring(e.resourceName), Type = tostring(e.resourceType), ['Resource group'] = tostring(e.resourceGroup), Kind = tostring(e.detector), ['Cost, last 30 days (USD)'] = todouble(e.costUsd30d), Status = tostring(e.status), Recommendation = tostring(e.recommendation), Confidence = todouble(e.confidence), ['Saving per month if removed (USD)'] = todouble(e.monthlySavingUsd), Summary = tostring(e.summary), Objections = tostring(e.objections), Guards = tostring(e.guards), Run = tostring(e.runId)
| order by When desc

content.title: Every step (the latest 1000 lines of the selected run, or of all runs)
content.query:
traces
| where message startswith 'meternaut_event '
| extend e = parse_json(substring(message, 16))
| where '{Run}' == '*' or tostring(e.runId) == '{Run}'
| project When = timestamp, Run = tostring(e.runId), Event = tostring(e.type), Case = tostring(e.caseId), Step = tostring(e.step), Model = tostring(e.model), ['Prompt tokens'] = toint(e.promptTokens), ['Completion tokens'] = toint(e.completionTokens), Milliseconds = toint(e.ms), OK = tobool(e.ok), Detail = coalesce(tostring(e.note), tostring(e.reason), tostring(e.resourceName), tostring(e.summary))
| order by When desc
| take 1000

content.title: What did not work (notes and failures)
content.query:
traces
| where message startswith 'meternaut_event '
| extend e = parse_json(substring(message, 16))
| extend type = tostring(e.type)
| where type in ('run.note', 'run.failed') or (type == 'case.result' and tostring(e.status) == 'error') or (type == 'case.step' and tobool(e.ok) == false)
| where '{Run}' == '*' or tostring(e.runId) == '{Run}'
| project When = timestamp, Run = tostring(e.runId), Event = type, Case = tostring(e.caseId), Step = tostring(e.step), Detail = coalesce(tostring(e.note), tostring(e.reason), tostring(e.summary))
| order by When desc

content.title: Tokens used by the runs, per day
content.query:
traces
| where message startswith 'meternaut_event '
| extend e = parse_json(substring(message, 16))
| where tostring(e.type) == 'run.finished'
| summarize Tokens = sum(toint(e.tokens)) by Day = bin(timestamp, 1d)
| order by Day asc
